entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis-Eugène Faucher was a highly decorated officer in the French Army with the rank of Général de corps d'armée and a member of the French Resistance during World War II. He is most noted for his service as a Head of the French Military Mission to Czechoslovakia 1926 to 1938.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis-Eugène Faucher was a highly decorated officer in the French Army with the rank of Général de corps d'armée and a member of the French Resistance during World War II. He is most noted for his service as a Head of the French Military Mission to Czechoslovakia 1926 to 1938.
